Natural colour artistic portrait with a soft, painterly feel. Ready made artwork, no photo needed. A lovely gift for any Golden Retriever lover, or a treat for your own walls.

CHOOSE YOUR OPTION
Print with border: a fine art print with a white border around the artwork, ready for your own frame.
Print borderless: the artwork printed edge to edge.
Framed with border: printed and framed in a black frame with a white border around the artwork, ready to hang.
Framed borderless: printed and framed in a black frame, with the artwork filling the frame, ready to hang.

SIZES
A4 (21 x 29.7 cm)
11 x 14 in (28 x 35.5 cm)
A3 (29.7 x 42 cm)
The sizes are the size of the print. A frame adds a little around the edge.

DELIVERY
Printed to order and dispatched within 5 to 7 working days.
Free tracked delivery to UK addresses. We currently deliver within Great Britain only.

WANT YOUR OWN PET?
We also create custom portraits of your own dog or cat in the Timeless, Signature, Gilded and Forever styles. Send us a message to find out more.

Please note colours may vary slightly between screens and the printed artwork.

Thank you for supporting a small UK business.
